review_rationale: Source registration for 18.5.5 and 18.5.5.1-18.5.5.9, the functions declared in ISO_Fortran_binding.h: CFI_address, CFI_allocate, CFI_deallocate, CFI_establish, CFI_is_contiguous, CFI_section, CFI_select_part and CFI_setpointer (batch244). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across three rounds; success paths and isolated named-error conditions are planned as C companion programs with exact results.
